name: Firebase Prolific Runner
description: Experiment runner for conducting human behavioral experiments with participant recruitment via Prolific and experiment hosting on Firebase.

parameters.name: study_name
parameters.description: Display name for the study in Prolific.

parameters.name: study_description
parameters.description: Study description visible to Prolific participants.

parameters.name: study_url
parameters.description: URL pointing to the hosted experiment.

parameters.name: study_completion_time
parameters.description: Estimated time in minutes for participants to complete.

parameters.name: completion_code
parameters.description: Code provided to participants upon study completion.

parameters.name: sleep_time
parameters.description: Interval in seconds between Firebase/Prolific status checks.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Experimental conditions to present to participants.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: Participant responses collected from the experiment.
